rerecorded.cause: src/entities/pools.ts setProceduralVisible() — the sprite-animator runtime land (c7f284ad4, merged dca019e23) changed "for (const part of this.renderParts) part.visible = visible" to "this.renderParts.forEach((part, index) => { part.visible = index === 0 || visible; })". renderParts[0] is the enemy pool GROUND SHADOW instanced mesh (assets.shadowGeometry x Balance.enemy.poolSize = 96 instances of 20 triangles = 1,920), and it now stays visible when the procedural bodies are hidden behind the generated sprites — deliberately, so a sprite-drawn enemy still has ground contact. LEGITIMATE, not a leak: nothing is constructed twice and nothing is left undisposed; the same instanced mesh simply survives the hide. It costs exactly +1 draw call and +1,920 triangles in every phase, on both projects.
